title: Where he lived in Kansas City; his stepfather; family moves to California
summary: He lived at Independence and Charlotte, later at the Lincoln Hotel; his mother remarried Lonnie Johnson around his sixteenth year.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Back...I want to get this on the tape. You told me off the tape but I...where you first lived in Kansas City you said was on Independence and Charlotte. Is that right?
That's right. Independence Avenue and Charlotte.
And then you moved to another location...in Kansas City?
You lived in the same place.
Then I moved out to Eighteenth and Vine...
At a hotel...called the Lincoln Hotel.
And when did your mother marry again? How old were you when your mother got married again?
Oh, I guess I'se about sixteen years old when she got married again.
Lonnie Johnson, and he lived...he lived in a good place called La Belle, Missouri...
And he lived in Kansas, too.
And then when did they come out to California?

They came out here after I bought my place of business. An' Momma an' them come out here. My sister came first... to visit me. Then my momma came to visit me. An' I went away and come back an' my whole family had moved out here. An' they been...they was here ever since. Can't drag 'em away from California.
